Understanding the available treatment options and deciding what may be right for your dog can feel overwhelming. CaniVax is developing new cancer drugs and therapeutic vaccines for dogs, using advances in modern cancer science to create additional treatment options for canine patients. Dogs Deserve Better Cancer Treatment Cancer is one of the most serious diseases affecting dogs. Surgery, chemotherapy, radiotherapy and supportive care can make a real difference, but important gaps remain. For many canine cancers, treatment options become more limited when the disease returns, progresses or stops responding to therapy. This can leave families facing difficult decisions. A treatment may control the cancer for a time but not prevent it from returning. Other options may become less suitable as the disease advances, or as treatment burden and quality of life become increasingly important. Vets – CaniVax Skip to content Dog Owners Vets Science Pipeline About Us News Dog Owners Vets Science Pipeline About Us News Contact Us Menu Information for Veterinary Professionals CaniVax is developing investigational cancer medicines for dogs, including oral drugs and therapeutic cancer vaccines. We work with veterinary professionals to explore clinical access for appropriate patients and to evaluate new treatments through veterinary clinical studies. Clinical Practicalities in Mind CaniVax is developing cancer medicines with practical features suited to veterinary oncology. Our lead drug CaniVive™ is an orally administered, room-temperature-stable tablet formulation, supporting straightforward treatment in clinical practice. Our cancer vaccines are pathology-specific. Our CaniMune™ platform identifies shared tumour antigens within a defined cancer type and incorporates them into multi-antigen vaccines designed for use across suitable patients. This creates a scalable approach to developing vaccines for melanoma and other canine cancers. They are necessary to advance the field of veterinary oncology and develop more effective and safer cancer treatments. At The Cancer Vet, we offer participation in clinical trials, providing your pet with access to innovative treatments that may not be available elsewhere. Our team follows rigorous protocols to ensure the safety and well-being of your pet throughout the trial. You can leverage our clinical trials by discussing with our team whether your pet is a suitable candidate for any ongoing trials. Participation in a clinical trial can provide your pet with access to cutting-edge treatments and contribute to the advancement of veterinary oncology. The Cancer Vet passionately delivers specialized comprehensive cancer care for pets, aiming to enhance their quality of life. Protect Animal Health NEWS 公司訊息 媒體報導 公司訊息 26 OCT 2025 田間試驗 受試者招募 一項多中心、隨機分配、開放標籤、雙臂田間試驗以評估PT001治療性疫苗在II-III期口腔惡性黑色素瘤犬隻中的安全性及有效性 試驗標題： 一項多中心、隨機分配、開放標籤、雙臂田間試驗以評估PT001治療性疫苗在II-III期口腔惡性黑色素瘤犬隻中的安全性及有效性。 試驗藥物：PT001 (PD-L1及CTLA-4重組蛋白疫苗) 背景： 本試驗為一項研究性質的田間試驗，旨在評估研究用試驗藥物（PT001）於腫瘤犬隻中的安全性與有效性。PT001為CTLA-4和PD-L1兩種靶點的重組蛋白疫苗（次蛋白疫苗），利用免疫檢查點（immune-checkpoint）的機制調控免疫反應，為仍在研發階段之研究產品。 本試驗的目的在於透過受試犬於試驗期間的生理狀況、檢測結果及免疫相關指標的觀察與紀錄，了解此研究產品在腫瘤犬隻中的反應情形，作為後續科學研究與產品開發之參考。 招募對象： ．經確診為口腔惡性黑色素瘤 II 期或 III 期犬隻。 ．1歲以上。 ．可配合試驗進行給藥與各項檢驗。 ．同意暫停其他治療方式。 不適用個案： ．若罹患嚴重肝腎疾病、自體免疫疾病、骨髓疾病及其他經獸醫師評估之高風險系統性疾病將無法納入本試驗。 ．必須使用類固醇或免疫抑制劑之患犬。 ．於進入試驗前曾接受放射線治療。 ．無法依照試驗計畫書進行團塊紀錄及測量。 流程： ．符合計劃書中的收案條件。 ．受試動物定期回診進行注射及評估。 注意： ．本試驗含對照組。 執行地點： ．台北- 國立台灣大學附設動物醫院 長青動物醫院 中和杜瑪動物醫院 ．台中- 國立中興大學獸醫教學醫院 泡泡動物醫院 吉米哈利動物醫院 沃可動物醫院 ．高雄- 中興梅西動物醫院 Back
